name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: "*"
  pull_request:
    branches: "*"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # First job primes the cache for all subsequent jobs
  install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo

  # lint:
  #   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  #   needs: install
  #   steps:
  #     - name: Checkout code
  #       uses: actions/checkout@v4
  #     - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo
  #     - name: Run linter
  #       run: npm run lint

  format-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: install
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo
      - name: Check formatting
        run: npm run format:check

  type-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: install
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo
      - name: Type check
        run: npm run typecheck

  # test:
  #   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  #   needs: install
  #   steps:
  #     - name: Checkout code
  #       uses: actions/checkout@v4
  #     - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo
  #     - name: Run tests
  #       run: npm run test

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: install
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-repo

      # Cache Next.js build output for faster subsequent builds
      - name: Restore Next.js build cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .next/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.js', '**/*.jsx', '**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx', '!node_modules/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build
        env:
          # Skip telemetry during CI builds
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1
          # Required build-time env vars
          NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: https://ci.zenithos.com
          NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID: ci-placeholder
          NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID: ci-placeholder
          NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_REGION: us-east-1
